prompt:
Full SIMPLIFICATION AND PALETTE UNIFICATION of the exact Chinese ghost-deity heavy guard in the provided image. User requests: colors unified, much simpler design, weapon removed.

REMOVE WEAPONS COMPLETELY:
Remove the entire sword, scabbard, red handle, sword guard and red tassel. No sword, polearm, shield or substitute weapon. Restore the cloth/body behind them. The old sword-holding hand is now an EMPTY armored hand, loosely closed, elbow comfortably bent near his side. The other fist stays lowered naturally. Exactly two hands, no lingering grip around an invisible handle.

UNIFIED COOL BLUE PALETTE:
Armor/clothing mostly COBALT BLUE and DEEP NAVY (about 75 percent of colored gear), simple muted STEEL-SILVER structural edges (about 20 percent), a tiny ICE-CYAN ghost-flame accent (about 5 percent).
Remove ALL red and bright gold from armor/mask/chest/sash/boots/ribbons. Red chest becomes navy-blue, red guardian mask becomes dark cobalt, gold metal becomes quiet cool steel-gray. Keep natural warm skin and dark hair/beard with original small ivory beard streak. The face is still the human focal point. Avoid neon blue or equally bright silver outlines on every piece.

DECISIVE REDUCTION OF COMPLEXITY:
Keep the main identity of ONE huge Chinese guardian-mask shoulder at SCREEN LEFT, but reconstruct it using ONLY a few broad forms: one blue brow shell, two small cyan eye slits, one simple dark muzzle/jaw and a single grouped pale tooth band. No many separate teeth, triple horns, carved curls, layers of border rings or tiny plates. Retain just ONE thick backward-curving architectural crest with a plain clipped end; remove the maze/spiral engraving and redundant tall horn on opposite shoulder.
Collar becomes THREE broad pale blue-gray mane/flame masses total, with just TWO simple ice-cyan upward ghost curls. Remove dozens of spiky fur locks and excessive flame tongues. No particle cloud.
Chest: ONE broad blue protective face with one deep navy lower plane and one plain steel upper edge. No layered red chest segments or gem-shaped pendants on both sides. DELETE the two large hanging diamond ornaments entirely.
Waist: ONE broad dark navy band with ONE plain rectangular steel buckle. Remove ornate intertwined belt relief.
Lower armor: just THREE large quiet blue apron/hip panels with one broad silver edge or folded face each. No scattered cloud stamps, repeated corner ornaments, tiny strips or nested layers. Undercloth navy.
Arms and legs: massive rounded-angular bracers, simple gauntlets, substantial knee/shin plates and boots, each only 2–3 big form planes. Remove all red ankle ties, tiny gold tabs and little spikes.
Remove long floating cloud-pattern ribbons to keep silhouette clean; at most ONE short plain blue-gray cloth tail behind the waist.
Do not reduce his heavy mass or turn him into a plain tunic soldier: maintain broad shoulders, thick arms/legs, compact heroic proportions, powerful planted stance and main mask-shoulder silhouette.

PRESERVE:
Same mature stern human face, dark swept hair, beard/ivory streak, broad body/head proportions and grounded two-foot stance. Same general viewing direction and hand locations except necessary weapon-removal adjustment. Organic skin, no gemstone shards across face.

PROJECT GEM ICON RENDER:
Strong clean deep-navy outer contour, very sparse inner lines. Exactly a few LARGE coherent matte base/light/shadow shapes per material. No tiny triangular mosaic, noise, gritty brush texture, glossy 3D metal, gradients everywhere, engravings or jewelry clutter. Main readable hierarchy: face -> oversized spirit shoulder -> broad blue armored body. Large quiet blue surfaces should occupy most of the design.
One finished full-body UNARMED male guard on square uniform warm ivory background, all shoulder/head/boots within safe margins. No props, text, frame, scene or floor shadow. The change must be visibly simpler and clearly unified blue/navy/steel.
purpose: User-selected ghost-general: remove weapon, unify blue/navy/steel palette and substantially simplify armor, mask and supernatural accents.
visual_review: Sword/scabbard removed; armor, mask and cloth unified to blue/navy/steel with cyan accents. Chest pendants and belt relief removed, armor panels and collar grouped more simply.
